text: Cavitation and flashing: continuous cavitation above the incipient-damage limit is not permitted; anti-cavitation trim or several stages where the pressure drop exceeds the limit; hardened trim for flashing and erosive services; outlet velocity of gas at 0.3 Mach or lower (0.5 Mach at the maximum flow for short durations), liquid outlet velocity of 8 m/s or lower, steam according to the design criteria of the piping.
